# Handoff Acknowledged ✓

## Quick Analysis

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS | Better |
|--------|----------|-----------|--------|
| Tuning Mean | 1.904 | 1.762 | Champion |
| Tuning Min | 0.431 | 0.051 | Champion ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | 1.793 | Tie |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | 1.347 | PASS |
| Worst MDD | -9.3% | -11.2% | Champion |

**Key Observations:**
- Champion remains stronger overall (better tuning stability, lower drawdown)
- PASS candidate's tuning_min of 0.05 is a red flag (near-zero on one fold)
- PASS candidate shows better lockbox_min (+19% improvement), suggesting possible overfitting on tuning set
- MDD delta of ~2% favors champion

## Recommendation

Champion holds. The PASS candidate's extremely low tuning_min indicates fragility that outweighs the lockbox_min improvement.

## Ready to Execute

```bash

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Shall I proceed with execution, or do you want to review/modify any parameters first?
